subject: Novel Method
source_sentence: We present a novel method that (1) exploits a pre-trained neural language model to obtain contextualised representations for every occurrence of a word of interest, (2) clusters these representations into usage types , and (3) measures change along time.
title: Analysing Lexical Semantic Change with Contextualised Word Representations
